Bootloader agent for bare-metal servers."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# d.sh"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A minimal coding agent for DeepSeek-compatible APIs, all in **one Bash file: `d.sh`**. It requires o"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"nly Bash 4.3+ and curl. On minimal servers without a full dependency stack, it can bootstrap a more "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"capable harness (Codex, Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness) or handle simple environment setup — serving "},{"id":"p4s4","text":"as a **bootloader agent**."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Quick Start"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"### Option 1: Run once with a one-line command (no script or configuration saved)"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Option 2: Save a configured copy and keep using it"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The first command downloads the script as `d.sh` in the current directory; any existing copy is over"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"written. The second runs it and starts an interactive setup for `BASE_URL`, `MODEL_NAME`, and `DEEPS"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"EEK_API_KEY`, then drops you into the interactive prompt. The chosen values are written back into `d"},{"id":"p10s4","text":".sh` with mode `600`, so later runs only need `bash d.sh`."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Option 3: Configure once, then start a session-less agent from anywhere"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Then use the command `d` to run the agent ANYWHERE ANYTIME you need."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The three connection settings are:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Variable | Purpose |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | API key; required |
| `BASE_URL` | DeepSeek-compatible API endpoint |
| `MODE"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"L_NAME` | Model sent with each request |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`BASE_URL` defaults to `https://api.deepseek.com` and `MODEL_NAME` to `deepseek-v4-flash`. `DEEPSEEK"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"_API_KEY` is always required. During interactive setup, press Enter to keep the displayed default; A"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"PI-key input is hidden. When setup runs from a saved copy, the selected values are written back to `"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"d.sh` and the file mode is changed to `600`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Other harness settings (`DSH_*`) are documented in the configuration block at the top of `d.sh`. Env"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ironment variables override values stored in the script and become the defaults shown during interac"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"riables override values stored in the script and become the defaults shown during interactive setup."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Sessions"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The conversation is saved to `session.jsonl` in the working directory and resumed automatically on t"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"he next run. Each line contains the role, a tab, and the message JSON. `/clear` empties the file. Se"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"t `DSH_SESSION_FILE` to another path, or to an empty value to disable persistence."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Only complete turns are written, so an interrupted run never resumes on a half-finished tool exchang"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ly complete turns are written, so an interrupted run never resumes on a half-finished tool exchange."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Tool | Description |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| `bash` | Persistent shell — cwd, environment, functions and virtualenvs survive across calls and t"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"urns |
| `str_replace_editor` | `view` / `create` / `str_replace` / `insert` on text files |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Interactive commands"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- `/compact` — summarize older history
- `/clear` — reset the conversation and persistent shell
- `/"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"exit` — quit
- `Ctrl+C` — cancel the in-flight model request or running command and return to the pr"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ompt; a running command also resets the persistent shell
- `Ctrl+D` — quit (same as `/exit`)"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## DeepSeek Harness alignment"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Behavior tracks the `sdk-minimal` profile of **deepseek-harness `dsh-v0.1.5-alpha.1` (`0.1.5-alpha.1"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"`)** — the last release whose `sdk-minimal` bundle shipped the **two-tool** profile. That bundle is "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"unchanged since `v0.1.3-alpha.2`; `dsh-v0.1.5-alpha.2` and later drop `str_replace_editor` and adver"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"tise only a persistent shell."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"What that means here:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- One persistent Bash shell (300-second timeout) plus `str_replace_editor`; the editor's upstream `m"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"axOutputChars: 16000` matches this script's `DSH_OUTPUT_LIMIT` and tool description.
- Persona defau"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"lts to `You are a helpful software engineer assistant.`, with no Harness identity or runtime context"},{"id":"p31s4","text":".
- Uncompressed JSONL sessions (here: `session.jsonl` in the working directory), a 1,000,000-token "},{"id":"p31s5","text":"fallback context window, and `danger-full-access` (no sandbox).
- Automatic compaction, tool-result "},{"id":"p31s6","text":"pruning and the `[Deep diving ...]` / `[Compacting context ...]` status text are adapted from the fu"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"ll harness of the same series (`compaction-basic`, `compaction-tool-result-pruner`, `ui-chat` locale"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"), because `sdk-minimal` itself excludes compaction."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The wire protocol is the OpenAI-compatible **Chat Completions** API: `POST {BASE_URL}/chat/completio"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"ns` with Bearer auth and `messages` / `tools` / `stream` / `max_tokens`, plus DeepSeek's `thinking` "},{"id":"p32s3","text":"and `reasoning_effort` extensions. This is the same protocol as upstream `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deeps"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"eek`; it is neither the legacy text Completions API (`/completions`) nor the OpenAI **Responses** AP"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"I (`/responses`, `input` / `instructions`)."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Commands run with your permissions and without a sandbox. Interactive setup stores the API key in th"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"e local `d.sh`; never commit or share that configured copy. Session files contain the full conversat"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"ion and should also remain outside version control."}],"truncated":false}
